That Roman villa you fell in love with? It may not be able to power your show.

Heritage buildings run on heritage electrics. Add full AV to a live catering kitchen and you trip the house supply — usually at load-in, when a generator is an emergency line item instead of a budgeted one.

The fix: ask for a power survey and the available amperage in writing before you sign, and price the generator as its own line from day one.
